title: Approved sources
intro: What {supplier} sells us and on what terms. Type in a cell: it is saved when you leave it.

unit.notUsableNote: A source whose unit the material no longer converts is bought in the material’s own unit until it is changed.

noAccess.title: Approved sources are Purchasing’s
noAccess.body: Your role cannot read them: it needs purchasing.view. Ask an administrator.

held.noManage: Your role cannot change approved sources (purchasing.sources.manage).
held.supplierArchived: The supplier is archived: it is no approved source any more.
held.busy: Wait: the last change is still being saved.
held.archived: Archived: restore it to change it.

empty.title: No items yet
empty.body: Add what this supplier sells us: the material, their code, unit, price, minimum, multiple and lead time. Importing a price list comes later.

add.title: Add a source of {supplier}
add.noMaterials: Finding a material needs product.materials.view: ask an administrator.
add.colourHint: A colour’s own source is used before the one of every colour.
add.companyHint: A source of every company needs a role over every company.
add.companyOneHint: This supplier supplies one company only.
add.unitHint: Any unit the material converts; by default its own ({unit}).
add.preferenceHint: One primary per material, colour and company.
add.priceHint: In the currency below; blank: no price yet.
add.leadHint: Blank: the supplier’s usual lead time.
add.noCost: Your role has no cost grain: the price is added by a buyer who sees costs.
add.primaryNote: The current primary source of this material, colour and company becomes a backup.

held.oneCompany: This supplier supplies one company only: its source holds for that company.
held.noCompany: Open a company first: a source holds for one company or for every company.
held.noCost: Your role has no cost grain: leave the price blank.
held.currency: A currency code of three letters (EUR).

refused.archived: The supplier or the material is archived: it cannot be an approved source.
refused.duplicate: This supplier already has an approved source of this material for this company and colour: change that one.
refused.everyCompany: A source of every company is kept only by a role over every company: choose this company.
refused.company: The supplier or the material belongs to one company: the source holds for that company.
refused.notSupplier: This party has no supplier role: give it one first.
refused.colour: Choose an active colour of this material.
refused.gone: The supplier or the material is no longer there.

bulk.noneActive: None of the picked sources is approved.
bulk.noneArchived: None of the picked sources is archived.

refused.restoreState: it cannot be approved again: the supplier or the material is archived, or it is approved already.
refused.restoreDuplicate: the supplier has another approved source of it for this company and colour: archive that one first.

readOnly.title: Read only
readOnly.body: Your role reads the approved sources but cannot change them: that needs purchasing.sources.manage (the buyer).

noCost: Prices are not shown: your role has no cost grain.

cell.label: {field} of {material}

refused.supplierArticleCode: Their code is at most 60 characters.
refused.supplierColourCode: Their colour code is at most 60 characters.
refused.description: The description is at most 300 characters.
refused.purchaseUom: The material does not convert this unit.
refused.unitPrice: A price of 0 or more, at most six decimals.
refused.minOrderQty: A minimum above 0, at most four decimals.
refused.orderMultiple: A multiple above 0, at most four decimals.
refused.currency: A currency code of three letters (EUR).
refused.note: The note is at most 1000 characters.

cell.badPrice: A price of 0 or more, at most six decimals.
cell.changed: Changed by someone else: read again, type it again.
cell.archived: Archived meanwhile: restore it to change it.
cell.unitNotConverted: The material does not convert this unit to its base unit.
cell.forbidden: Your role cannot change this source (a source of every company needs a role over every company).

problem.invalid: Not saved: check what you typed.
problem.offline: No answer from the server: try again in a moment.
problem.changed: Changed by someone else: read again.
problem.slowDown: Too many tries: wait a moment.

archive.body: An archived source is no longer offered when buying: the supplier is not approved for it any more. It is kept, and may be approved again.

restore.body: Each comes back as a backup source. Its terms are as they were when it was archived.

notice.changed: {material} was changed by someone else: the row was read again.
notice.addedDemoted: Source of {material} added as primary: {supplier} is now the backup.

prices.title: Supplier prices
prices.intro: The approved suppliers of this material with their price, minimum, pack size and lead time. They are kept in Purchasing, on each supplier’s Items & prices.
prices.noAccess: Supplier prices are Purchasing’s: your role needs purchasing.view to read them.
prices.onlyDefault: Only the default supplier: {supplier}. No approved source yet.
prices.none: No approved source yet, and no default supplier.
